$comment: Everything shipped to the browser. gen-licenses.mjs embeds these files into /licenses/ and fails the build if one is missing. `files` are paths inside the npm package; `localFiles` are paths relative to the repo root (license texts the package does not ship, see licenses/third-party/SOURCES.md). Entries with `component` instead of `name` describe code compiled into a package (no npm package of their own). Entries with "autoframe": true ship only when PUBLIC_ID_PHOTO_AUTOFRAME is on (scripts/lib/autoframe.mjs); gen-licenses drops them otherwise. Entries with "bgremove": true ship only when PUBLIC_BG_REMOVE is on (scripts/lib/bgremove.mjs; Sprint C, C2).
